name: Craft Youth Culture teen program
what_you_do: A free program for high school students. Teens visit galleries, talk about art, work with contemporary artists, and do hands-on artmaking projects and guest talks.
who_can_apply: High school students. Ages and grades are not stated.
pay_detail: The page calls it a free program.
duration: Dates not on the program pages
deadline_text: Current dates and deadline are not on the program pages. The site lists a 2026 to 2027 page and an older 2025 to 2026 link, so confirm which is current.
how_to_apply: Use the Learn More and Apply link on the Craft Contemporary teens page. You can also call 323-937-4230. Or email info@craftcontemporary.org.
notes: Ask about ages, the application date and whether any stipend is paid. The permit field is false only because it is described as a free program, not a job.
